C0558.title: Man Exploits E-Commerce Loophole by Refusing Delivery to Scam Over ¥100,000 in Goods
C0558.summary: A man surnamed Song used others' identities to place cash-on-delivery orders for high-value electronics like laptops on online shopping platforms. After merchants shipped the items, he deliberately refused delivery, forged the seller's identity, and instructed Lalamove drivers to intercept the returned packages at courier stations.
